# Rise and Battle the Day

## Scripture
"Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13

## Reflection
The alarm goes off. Your body says stay down; your spirit knows it's time to rise. Every morning is a battlefield, and the first fight isn't with the world—it's with the flesh that whispers, *just five more minutes, just one more excuse.*

Paul's charge to the Corinthians wasn't a suggestion. It was a command given to men: be watchful, stand firm, act like men, be strong. Notice the order. Watchfulness comes first. A soldier who sleeps through the alarm loses ground before the battle even starts. Faithfulness in the small hours—getting up, getting in the Word, getting after your body—builds the spiritual muscle you'll need when the real trials hit.

Strength isn't born in comfort. It's forged in the daily decision to do the hard thing when no one is watching. God isn't asking for perfection. He's asking for men who show up, suit up, and refuse to quit. Today is a gift. Don't sleep through it.

## Daily Challenge
Before you do anything else, drop and do 20 pushups—one for each word of 1 Corinthians 16:13. Thank God for the strength to rise and fight another day.
